Insert an image on top of the screenshot
from the clipboard (Ctrl+V), from a file, or as a new capture

editor.no_image: There is no image on the clipboard

editor.ocr_no_text: No text found in the screenshot

editor.pen_hint_color_title: Color changed for this object only

editor.pen_hint_size_title: Thickness changed for this object only
editor.select_text_first: First select text with the mouse (Ctrl+A: all)

editor.text_color_tip: Text color in numbers and callouts
editor.tip_blur:
Blur (B)
Select the area to hide
editor.tip_callout:
Callout (K)
Click the point to indicate and drag to where the text will be
Ctrl+Enter: finish typing
editor.tip_crop:
Crop (C)
Select the area to keep. Shift: square
Ctrl+Z: undo
editor.tip_darrow:
Double-headed arrow (D)
Shift: horizontal, vertical or 45°
editor.tip_eraser:
Eraser (X)
Whole: the touched object is removed entirely
Partial: erases parts of objects (only parts of the selected object, if there is one)
Brush size: thickness buttons 1-5. The eraser does not touch the screenshot itself
editor.tip_farrow:
Freehand arrow (F)
Draw freely with the mouse: the line is smoothed and wobbles caused by hand movement are corrected
editor.tip_fline:
Smooth line (G)
Draw freely with the mouse: the line is smoothed and wobbles caused by hand movement are corrected
editor.tip_fshape:
Freehand shape (O)
Draw any outline: the stroke is smoothed and closed automatically
Ctrl at the start: filled shape
editor.tip_move:
Select and move (V)
Click an object to select it, drag the handles to change it
Mouse wheel over an object: thickness/size
Number and callout: the number circle/callout box and its leader line can be dragged separately, Shift: together
Ctrl + drag: duplicate, Delete: remove
Double-click text to edit it
editor.tip_number:
Number (N)
Click: number 1, 2, 3…
Click and drag: a number with a leader line
Each color has its own count
editor.tip_ocr:
Copy text (I)
The screenshot is recognized and the words found are highlighted.
Drag the mouse over the words you need, like a marker: the selection opens in a window for copying
Ctrl + stroke: add another piece, double-click: one word, Ctrl+A: all text, Esc: exit
editor.tip_text:
Text (T)
Click: start typing, Ctrl+Enter or a click elsewhere: finish, Esc: cancel
editor.tip_translate:
Translate selection (Y)
Select text on the screenshot with the mouse: the language is detected automatically and the translation appears on top.
You can drag the translation aside; “Copy”, “Original”, the cross. Esc: exit
The whole screenshot at once: Shift+Y. The translation is not included in the saved screenshot
editor.tr_all_busy: Translating the whole screenshot… Esc: cancel
editor.tr_all_done: The whole screenshot is translated. “Original” shows the source text
editor.tr_lang_tip: Translation language: choosing one re-translates all pieces
editor.tr_message_tip:
Draw around a piece of the screenshot with the mouse: the language is detected automatically and the translation appears on top. You can drag the translation aside; “Original” brings back the source text.
The translation is not included in the saved screenshot. Esc or “Done”: exit.
editor.tr_nothing_to_copy: Nothing to copy yet: no translated pieces
editor.tr_sel_tip: Translate selection: select text with the mouse (Y)
editor.tr_sub: Drawing tools are hidden while translating
editor.tr_view_card_tip: Translation in a separate card window
editor.tr_view_overlay_tip: The translation is placed over the text on the screenshot
editor.unsaved_text: If you close without saving, your changes to the screenshot will be lost.
editor.zoom_fit_tip: Show the whole screenshot in the window (Ctrl+9)
